title: Man Utd's 2008 final XI
brief: Name the ten outfield players who started for Man Utd against Chelsea in the 2008 Champions League final (21 May 2008), when they drew 1-1 and won on penalties. The goalkeeper (Edwin van der Sar) is left out.

notes.Ryan Giggs: Ryan Giggs came on as a substitute in the 2008 final, so he did not start.
notes.Nani: Nani came on as a substitute in the 2008 final, so he did not start.
notes.Anderson: Anderson came on as a substitute in the 2008 final, so he did not start.

checks: Starting XI, positions and shirt numbers from the team sheet on the final's Wikipedia page; the same eleven players and shirt numbers are on the Transfermarkt match report. Positions are Wikipedia's.
